name: Theme Modal UI
description: UI interaction spec for the theme selection dialog.

dom.overlay: .modal-overlay (display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(8,14,22,0.72); z-index:200)
dom.modal: .modal (min-width:380px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.45))
structure: .modal-header (padding:16px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); font-size:13px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em)
.modal-radio (display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 12px; cursor:pointer; font-size:13px; color:var(--primary); border-radius:6px; transition:background 0.1s)
button.btn-ghost#theme-cancel (padding:6px 12px; background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border); font-size:11px; cursor:pointer; letter-spacing:0.05em)
button.btn-primary#theme-apply (padding:7px 16px; background:var(--primary); color:var(--bg); border:none; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; letter-spacing:0.05em)

interactions.name: open
interactions.action: Re-render modal HTML to match current theme.isDark, set overlay display:flex, store onClose callback

interactions.name: apply
interactions.action: Read selected radio value, call theme.setDark(true/false), hide overlay (display:none), fire onClose callback, clear onClose reference

interactions.name: cancel
interactions.action: Hide overlay without applying, fire onClose callback

interactions.name: overlay_dismiss
interactions.action: Same as cancel — hide and fire callback without applying

states.visible: Overlay display:flex, onClose callback stored and active
